chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Fasting is a shield from the Fire."

key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم who conveys divine guidance
key_terms.ٱلصَّوْمُ: Fasting; abstaining in devotion to Allah

ai.seo_question: How is fasting described in hadith as protection from the Fire?
ai.summary: This hadith states that fasting serves as a protection from the Fire. It highlights the spiritual merit of sawm (fasting) and its role in safeguarding the believer in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1771 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Fasting is a shield from the Fire."
